name: after call log
script:
# Check if lead field is set
if not doc.lead:
    frappe.throw("Lead field is required. Please select a lead before saving.")

# Get the linked lead document
lead_doc = frappe.get_doc("Lead Management", doc.lead)

# Update lead status to "Contacted" when call log is created
lead_doc.lead_status = "Contacted"

# Update last contact date
lead_doc.last_contact_date = doc.call_date

# Increment total calls
if lead_doc.total_calls:
    lead_doc.total_calls = lead_doc.total_calls + 1
else:
    lead_doc.total_calls = 1

# Check lead response and update status accordingly
if doc.lead_response == "Yes - Interested":
    lead_doc.lead_status = "Qualified"
    
elif doc.lead_response == "No - Not Interested":
    lead_doc.lead_status = "Unqualified"
    
elif doc.lead_response == "Maybe - Need Follow Up":
    lead_doc.lead_status = "Follow Up"
    # Set next follow-up date if provided
    if doc.next_followup_date:
        lead_doc.next_followup_date = doc.next_followup_date
    frappe.msgprint("Lead marked as Follow Up - Needs further engagement")

# Save the lead document
lead_doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
lead_doc.save()

# Show success message
frappe.msgprint("Lead status updated to " + lead_doc.lead_status, alert=True, indicator='green')

name: After Follow Up
script:
# Check if lead field is set
if not doc.lead:
    frappe.throw("Lead field is required")

# Get the linked lead document
lead_doc = frappe.get_doc("Lead Management", doc.lead)

# Update last contact date
lead_doc.last_contact_date = doc.followup_date

# Update lead status based on follow up response
if doc.response == "Interested":
    lead_doc.lead_status = "Qualified"
    frappe.msgprint("Lead marked as Qualified - Showing interest")
    
elif doc.response == "Not Interested":
    lead_doc.lead_status = "Unqualified"
    frappe.msgprint("Lead marked as Unqualified - Not interested")
    
elif doc.response == "Need More Time":
    lead_doc.lead_status = "Follow Up"
    # Set next follow up if provided
    if doc.next_followup_date:
        lead_doc.next_followup_date = doc.next_followup_date
    frappe.msgprint("Lead marked as Follow Up - Needs more time to decide")
    
elif doc.response == "Ready to Buy":
    lead_doc.lead_status = "Hot Lead"
    frappe.msgprint("Lead marked as Hot Lead - Ready to buy!")
    
elif doc.response == "No Response":
    lead_doc.lead_status = "Follow Up"
    # Set next follow up if provided
    if doc.next_followup_date:
        lead_doc.next_followup_date = doc.next_followup_date
    frappe.msgprint("Lead marked as Follow Up - No response received")

# Save the lead document
lead_doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
lead_doc.save()

# Show final status with alert
frappe.msgprint("Lead status updated to: " + lead_doc.lead_status, alert=True, indicator='green')

name: calculate item
script:
# Calculate item amounts and totals
total = 0

if doc.items:
    for item in doc.items:
        # Convert to float to avoid string multiplication error
        quantity = float(item.quantity or 0)
        rate = float(item.rate or 0)
        
        # Calculate amount for each item
        item.amount = quantity * rate
        total = total + item.amount

# Set total amount
doc.total_amount = total

# Calculate discount amount
if doc.discount_percentage:
    discount_pct = float(doc.discount_percentage or 0)
    doc.discount_amount = (total * discount_pct) / 100
else:
    doc.discount_amount = 0

# Amount after discount
amount_after_discount = total - doc.discount_amount

# Calculate tax amount
if doc.tax_percentage:
    tax_pct = float(doc.tax_percentage or 0)
    doc.tax_amount = (amount_after_discount * tax_pct) / 100
else:
    doc.tax_amount = 0

# Calculate grand total
doc.grand_total = amount_after_discount + doc.tax_amount

# Round to 2 decimals
doc.total_amount = round(doc.total_amount, 2)
doc.discount_amount = round(doc.discount_amount, 2)
doc.tax_amount = round(doc.tax_amount, 2)
doc.grand_total = round(doc.grand_total, 2)

name: update lead status
script:
# Update lead status when quotation is created
if doc.lead:
    lead_doc = frappe.get_doc("Lead Management", doc.lead)
    
    # Update lead status to Qualified if not already
    if lead_doc.lead_status not in ["Hot Lead", "Qualified"]:
        lead_doc.lead_status = "Qualified"
    
    lead_doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    lead_doc.save()
    
    frappe.msgprint("Quotation created and lead status updated", alert=True, indicator='green')

name: Quotation Status Change
Probability Calculation
script:
# Auto-set probability based on sales stage
if doc.sales_stage and not doc.probability:
    stage_probability = {
        "Prospecting": 10,
        "Qualification": 20,
        "Needs Analysis": 40,
        "Proposal": 60,
        "Negotiation": 80,
        "Closed Won": 100,
        "Closed Lost": 0
    }
    doc.probability = stage_probability.get(doc.sales_stage, 0)

# Calculate probability weighted amount using basic Python
if doc.expected_revenue and doc.probability:
    expected_rev = float(doc.expected_revenue or 0)
    prob = float(doc.probability or 0)
    doc.weighted_amount = (expected_rev * prob) / 100
else:
    doc.weighted_amount = 0

# Update status based on sales stage
if doc.sales_stage == "Closed Won":
    doc.status = "Won"
    doc.actual_close_date = frappe.utils.today()
    doc.actual_revenue = doc.expected_revenue
    
elif doc.sales_stage == "Closed Lost":
    doc.status = "Lost"
    doc.actual_close_date = frappe.utils.today()
    
elif doc.sales_stage in ["Proposal", "Negotiation"]:
    doc.status = "Quotation Sent"
    
elif doc.sales_stage in ["Qualification", "Needs Analysis"]:
    doc.status = "In Progress"
    
else:
    doc.status = "Open"

# Round amounts to 2 decimals using Python's round()
doc.weighted_amount = round(float(doc.weighted_amount or 0), 2)
if doc.actual_revenue:
    doc.actual_revenue = round(float(doc.actual_revenue or 0), 2)

name: opportunity Script for Won/Lost Updates
script:
# Update lead status when opportunity is won or lost
if doc.lead and doc.status:
    lead_doc = frappe.get_doc("Lead Management", doc.lead)
    
    if doc.status == "Won":
        lead_doc.lead_status = "Converted"
        frappe.msgprint("Opportunity Won! Lead marked as Converted", indicator='green')
        
    elif doc.status == "Lost":
        lead_doc.lead_status = "Lost"
        frappe.msgprint("Opportunity Lost", indicator='red')
    
    lead_doc.flags.ignore_permissions = True
    lead_doc.save()
